mechanism: the same as the Rust RUST_DEFECT fixed in 361a197 (rust_defect_v5_growing_mode_damping.md): a growing mode started below the tolerance scale is not seen by the error control of the nominal run, which then integrates the unstable loop as a held setpoint and returns ok. LSODA's internal step-size and order selection is not instrumented here; the observable fact is the nominal answer against the converged runs of both implementations
consequence: on closed loops with an eigenvalue Re lambda > 0 at the steady start or at an event equilibrium, the reference's nominal-tolerance transient output (P42 transient_run, P43 transient_case, P45 orbit_simulated) is not a trustworthy comparison target: parity on such vectors is scored against the converged (tightened) reference answer, citing this record
the reference itself is not changed; no Python result, golden or fixture is rewritten
